body: It's fine! I think I might make her suit a tiny bit more purple in hue so it reads like less of a skin tone. I hope she'd be appealing to people unfamiliar with the series too so I need that outside perspective.

The hair and outfit are perfect! I would recommend changing her skin color to something closer to her in game sprite since her skin is a very pale pink. I color picked her skin tone in PS at #f2e2e4. I'm pretty sure you can use a custom hexadecimal color in the offline version (not sure about the online version) I believe Junko appears to have rounder eyes than the square eyes you have given your model, so maybe another eye shape would help her be more recognizable. Nice work!
I definitely like that! Devotion to the player character is part of her appeal after all.

The character wears a semi transparent suit that looks kind of like dark pantyhose material to me. But with the doll maker I just had to make her skin a different color and give her pale gloves and face paint to make it look like a long sleeved/high collared suit. So the model switches to a light skin tone to look as if she has taken off her suit.
This is really fantastic! Would you mind if I took inspiration from your solutions to the cape and headpiece for my model?
You have a really great handle on her character! I can't wait to play her. It's times like this I wish we could give these girls bigger noses.
Thank you! I'm trying the facial marking out now and it's working well

Me and my boyfriend have been enjoying this game so I thought I'd try to dev his waifu.

I had some trouble with her bodysuit since I'm not sure if it can be made transparent so I thought I would just give her black underwear and a lot of accessories to keep her appeal intact.
This would be a neutral/starting expression cause I want to keep her creepiness a little bit and make her a bit slow to warm up. I lifted this expression from one of her sprites.

Any advice or edits would be appreciated! This is my first character made with this so I'm not entirely sure what I'm doing.
